item.title: Netotteya
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Youkai Tamanokoshi
  • 発売日: 2019-03-15
  • スコア: 7.0200000000000005/10 (47 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ネトッテヤ
  • 英語名: Netotteya

あらすじ

I’m told that I have a wonderful wife.

She’s kind, and cheerful, and too good of a wife for me.

That’s why I can’t tell anyone. In reality…

[I want to see you get violated by another man.]

I held these dark thoughts for years…

Unable to hold it in anymore, I mention this fetish as a joke.

  • 日本語名: デモジツ!
  • 英語名: Demojitsu!

あらすじ

I always liked my big sisters.

Not as sisters, but as women…

We were pretty young… we’d take baths together

and the girls would mess with my junk.

It was innocent, but it never really stopped.

When stress mounts, my sisters mount me.

They’re experts at sucking my asshole and yanking me off.

One day I tried to confront them.

item.title: Nozokibeya
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Youkai Tamanokoshi
  • 発売日: 2015-05-01
  • スコア: 6.67/10 (99 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ノゾキベヤ
  • 英語名: Nozokibeya

别名

  • Look Down Room

あらすじ

I worked late every night. But it was not terrible.

My boss never praised me. But I was not unfulfilled.

I did it for my beloved daughter…

I was divorced some fifteen, twenty years ago.

My wife was gone. But I was not lonely. She left a gift.

Each night I came home to her wonderful cooking.

item.title: Love Netori
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Youkai Tamanokoshi
  • 発売日: 2013-08-11
  • スコア: 6.68/10 (67 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ラブネトリ
  • 英語名: Love Netori

あらすじ

When I was young my parents got divorced.

I wasn’t sad, though, because I still had two older sisters.

Mayuri was from a previous marriage.

The other was my true sister Saki.

One was kind, one was kind of a jerk.

At some point I fell in love with them both.

But, reality isn’t a game.

But one day my fatally boring life changed.

It started with a spam mail promising a method of mesmerism.

Pffssh, whatever, I thought… and gave it a try.

item.description:

  • スコア: 6.32/10 (49 人評価)
  • 日本語名: つまどり
  • 英語名: Tsumadori

别名

  • Wife Mount (Tsumadori)

あらすじ

My wife nursed our baby boy. She gave this family all her love.

Every day was a perfect glorious day.

But… amid that bliss, a crack formed…

I found an online video site starring a woman who looked very much like my wife…

The site used a filter to cover the faces of its actresses.
